subject: Environment onboarding timeline & network checklist
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@medalign.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Environment onboarding timeline & network checklist

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation this week. Per our MAP discussion, I wanted to capture a concise onboarding checklist and a proposed timeline so your infra and security teams can evaluate the scope before we kick off the evaluation run. Primary items we typically need to unblock a MedAlign-style evaluation: 

- Organization setup: Redwood org invite + role assignment for your infra lead (we'll share the invite link).
- API key provisioning: short-lived eval keys and instructions for rotating them during the trial.
- Network allowlist: outbound IP ranges for our hosted endpoints (we'll provide the list) and any required firewall rules.
- VPC peering (optional): template for peering request + expected maintenance window.
- Success criteria & timeline: target 2-week eval with staging throughput sample and token-cost check.

I've attached a compact checklist (env_onboarding_checklist.csv) and a VPC peering template you can drop into your ticketing system. Proposed milestone dates (flexible):
- Day 0: org invite + API key delivered
- Day 1–2: IP allowlist applied by MedAlign infra
- Day 3–5: smoke tests + sample inference
- Day 7–14: load run and quality check; decision point at Day 14

Can you confirm the right contact for the VPC peering request (if you want peering) and whether your security team prefers short-lived keys or scoped long-lived keys for the eval?

Thanks — I can coordinate a 30-min kick-off with Ben and Hannah once we have the contacts.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachment: env_onboarding_checklist.csv (csv)
attachment: vpc_peering_template.txt (txt)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah@medalign.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: it@medalign.com
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Environment onboarding timeline & network checklist

Thanks Chloe — this is very clear. Quick answers from our side: 

- VPC peering: we'll likely avoid peering for the initial eval and rely on the hosted endpoints behind our firewall. Please send the IP ranges.
- IP allowlist contact: IT Ops (it@medalign.com) will own the allowlist changes.
- API keys: security prefers short-lived eval keys (48h) with scoped monitoring. Is that possible?
- Kick-off: Tue or Wed next week works for us. Prefer morning PT.

I'll loop in our infra lead if we decide to pursue peering later — for now, IT Ops will take the checklist and open a ticket.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Director of Product
MedAlign

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Sep 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Environment onboarding timeline & network checklist

Hi Sarah —

Great, thanks for the quick turn. Short answers on our side: we can issue scoped short-lived API keys (48 hours) and add an automated rotation note for the trial. I'll coordinate with our security team to ensure logs are forwarded to your SOC on request (we can set up a short retention export for the eval).

Chloe — I attached the apikey provisioning runbook (apikey-provisioning-instructions.md) and noted where IT Ops should include the allowlist entries. Ben, please confirm if we should adjust the Day 3–5 smoke window to avoid your scheduled customer demo on Day 4.

Thanks,
